headline: Trump-backed crypto bill Clarity Act blocked by US Senate: What it means for Bitcoin, investors | Today News
summary: The US Senate blocked the Trump-backed Clarity Act, leaving several questions on crypto regulation unresolved. Experts said the near-term impact will be limited, but prolonged uncertainty could affect institutions.
why: US crypto market-structure legislation determines how digital assets are classified and supervised, which affects institutional participation.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The input says the blocked bill raises regulatory uncertainty for Bitcoin, with near-term impact expected to be limited.
